  "data": "@startuml
title Class Diagram - Online Event Management & Ticketing System
skinparam classAttributeIconSize 0

'================================================
' USER DOMAIN
'================================================
abstract class User {
    # userId: String
    # fullName: String
    # email: String
    # passwordHash: String
    # phoneNumber: String
    # status: UserStatus
    + login(): String
    + logout(): Void
    + updateProfile(): Boolean
    + verifyEmail()     : Boolean
    + resetPassword()   : Boolean
}

class Customer {
    + browseEvents(): List<Event>
    + bookTicket(): String
    + cancelBooking(): Boolean
    + viewHistory(): void
}
    
class Organizer {
    + createEvent(): String
    + updateEvent(): Boolean
    + manageOrders(): List<Order>
    + manageTickets(): List<Ticket>
    + viewReports(): List<Report>
}

class Staff {
    + scanQRCode(): String
    + validateTicket(): Boolean
}

class Admin {
    + manageUsers(): Boolean
    + managePayments(): Boolean
    + manageQRCode(): Boolean
    + manageRoles(): Boolean
}

class Role {
    - roleId: String
    - roleName: String
    + assignPermission(): Boolean
    + getPermissions(): List<Permission>
}

class Permission {
    - permissionId: String
    - permissionName: String
}

enum UserStatus {
    ACTIVE
    INACTIVE
    BLOCKED
}

User <|-- Customer
User <|-- Organizer
User <|-- Staff
User <|-- Admin

User "1" -- "1" Role
Role "1" -- "1..*" Permission

'================================================
' EVENT DOMAIN
'================================================
class Event {
    - eventId: String
    - title: String
    - description: String
    - status: EventStatus
    - createAt: DateTime
    - updatedAt: DateTime
    - publishedAt: DateTime
    + publish(): Boolean
    + updateInfo(): Boolean
    + cancel(): Boolean
    + getAvailableTickets() : Integer
    + getCheckInRate() : Float
}

class Venue {
    - venueId: String
    - venueName: String
    - address: String
    - capacity: Integer
}

class SeatingMap {
    - mapId: String
    - layoutName: String
    - totalCapacity : Integer
    + generateLayout(): Void
    + getAvailableSeats() : List<Seat>
}

class SeatingZone {
    - zoneId: String
    - zoneName: String
    - basePrice: Decimal
    - totalSeats : Integer
    + getAvailableSeats() : Integer
    + updatePricing() : Boolean
    + assignSeats() : void
}

class Seat {
    - seatId: String
    - row: String
    - column: Interger
    - seatNumber: Integer
    - status: SeatStatus
    + hold() : Boolean
    + release() : Boolean
    + block(): Boolean
    + isAvailable() : Boolean
}

enum EventStatus {
    DRAFT
    PUBLISHED
    CANCELLED
}

enum SeatStatus {
    AVAILABLE
    RESERVED
    SOLD
    BLOCKED
}

Organizer "1" -- "0..*" Event
Event "1" --> "1" Venue
Event "1" *-- "1" SeatingMap
SeatingMap "1" *-- "1..*" SeatingZone
SeatingZone "0..*" *--"1" Seat

'================================================
' TICKETING DOMAIN
'================================================
class Order {
    - orderId: String
    - orderDate: DateTime
    - totalPrice: Doublue
    - orderStatus: OrderStatus
    + calculateTotal(): Double
    + resendTickets(): Boolean
}

class OrderItem {
    - orderItemId: String
    - quantity: Integer
    - unitPrice: Decimal
    - subTotal: Decimal
    + calculateSubtotal(): Decimal
    + getTicket(): List<Ticket>
}

class Ticket {
    - ticketId: String
    - ticketCode: String
    - ticketStatus: TicketStatus
    - checkedInAt : DateTime
    - issuedAt : DateTime
    + generateQRCode(): String
    + invalidate(): Boolean
}

class TicketType {
    - ticketTypeId: String
    - name: String
    - price: Decimal
    - quantity: Integer
    - salesStatus: TicketSalesStatus
    - description: String
    - totalQuantity: Integer
    - soldQuantity: Integer
    - maxPerOrder : Integer
    - salesStart: DateTime
    - salesEnd: DateTime
    - salesStatus: TicketSalesStatus
    + updatePrice(): Boolean
    + updateQuantity(): Boolean
    + openSales(): Boolean
    + closeSales(): Boolean
}

class QRCode {
    - qrCodeID: String
    - payload : String
    - status : QRStatus
    - issuedAt : DateTime
    - expiredAt : DateTime
    - usedAt : DateTime
    + generateQR(ticketId) : String
    + validate() : Boolean
    + invalidate() : void
    + markAsUsed() : Boolean
    + regenerateQR() : QRCode
    + detectDuplicate() : Boolean
}

enum OrderStatus {
    PENDING
    PAID
    CANCELLED
    REFUNDED
}

enum TicketStatus {
    VALID
    USED
    CANCELLED
}

enum TicketSalesStatus {
    OPEN
    CLOSED
}

Customer "1" -- "0..*" Order
Order "1" *-- "1..*" OrderItem
OrderItem "*" --> "1" TicketType
OrderItem "1" --> "0..1" Seat
Ticket "*" --> "1" Event
Ticket "*" --> "1" TicketType
Ticket "0..1" --> "1" Seat
OrderItem "1" *-- "1..*" Ticket
Event "1" *-- "1..*" TicketType
Ticket "1" *-- "1" QRCode
Staff "0..*" -- "0..*"  QRCode
'================================================
' PAYMENT DOMAIN
'================================================
class Payment {
    - paymentId: String
    - paymentDate: DateTime
    - amount: Decimal
    - status: PaymentStatus
    - transactionCode: String
    + verify(): Boolean
    + refund(): Boolean
}

class PaymentGateway {
    + processPayment(): Boolean
    + validatePayment(): Boolean
    + refundPayment(): Boolean
}

enum PaymentStatus {
    PENDING
    SUCCESS
    FAILED
    REFUNDED
}

Order "1" --> "1" Payment
Payment ..> PaymentGateway

'================================================
' CHECK-IN DOMAIN
'================================================
class CheckIn {
    - checkInId: String
    - checkInTime: DateTime
    - result: CheckInStatus
    + verifyTicket(): Boolean
}

enum CheckInStatus {
    SUCCESS
    INVALID
    DUPLICATE
}

Ticket "1" --> "0..1" CheckIn
Staff "1" -- "0..*" CheckIn

'================================================
' REPORT DOMAIN
'================================================
class Report {
    - reportId: String
    - reportType: String
    - generatedDate: DateTime
    + generate(): Boolean
    + exportPDF(): File
    + exportCSV() : File
}

Organizer "1" -- "0..*" Report
Admin "1" -- "0..*" Report
